rule: One active effect per type, chosen by spell value times effectiveness (tie to the newcomer). A weaker buff from another caster is parked and wakes when the active one ends; a weaker debuff is refused. Hard CC on players has no ladder: a second stun is refused while one is active, and a player immunity window follows the end. Hard CC on NPCs has a per-target ladder: the first stun is full; each later stun in the window gets base / (2 x count); a stun under 1000 ms is refused; the window is flat or adaptive. Hit chance scales CC length (shorter below 55, longer above 100, capped at 200); style stuns are exempt. Stat totals: each effect writes into a category per property; debuffs erode buffs first, then base and item stat at a lower rate; player buff totals are capped by level. Bleed is a DoT whose per-tick damage falls by one per tick, not below one. Snare and root are one class (root at 99 or more). Fear is an NPC-only brain pushed on the brain stack, re-planned every 3,000 ms, walking away from the nearest player.
